script_text: Something is coming this week that will shake your Fire element and ruling planet Jupiter to the absolute core. Monday and Tuesday bring a heavy Moon square to your ruling planet Jupiter in your 9th House, causing emotional friction in love. However, a trine to your 7th House Saturn anchors a deeply romantic commitment Wednesday. The major turning point happens Wednesday when the Moon enters Scorpio, activating your 5th House of passion and creativity. Thursday through Sunday, your Fire element reignites as Mercury conjunct your 2nd House Venus attracts a major financial windfall. Meanwhile, Mars trines your 10th House Midheaven, securing prominent career promotion and a bonus. Tuesday is your worst day because the Moon squares Jupiter in your 9th House, but Saturday is your best day because the Sun trines your 7th House. Trust your intuition when making major decisions. Follow for daily updates.
